input.title: Unisex Golf – Not Cheating. Improving My Lie. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

NOT CHEATING. IMPROVING MY LIE. This golf lover zip up hoodie is for the golfer who gives the ball a little nudge when nobody is looking, worn to the first tee, the cart path and the nineteenth hole.

On the back, a smug raccoon in a flat cap and an argyle sweater vest strolls through tall rough with a club tucked behind his back, kicking his ball to a better spot, under NOT CHEATING. in heavy capitals above and IMPROVING MY LIE. below. The lettering is cream on Black and Navy and deep navy on Ash. On the front, a golf ball sitting up on a tee in a tuft of grass is embroidered on the left chest and the word LIE is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest golf ball on a tee and left-cuff LIE, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Black, Navy, Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

Where are the print and the embroidery on this golf zip hoodie?
The full raccoon and NOT CHEATING. IMPROVING MY LIE. lettering are printed across the back of this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, so the zipper never splits the art. On the front, a small embroidered golf ball on a tee sits on the left chest and LIE is stitched on the left cuff.

Is it a men's or a women's golf hoodie?
Both. It is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL, so most golfers order their usual size and go up one for room over a polo. The raccoon joke works for anyone who has ever improved a lie, and Graphic Tees Co. offers one free size exchange within 30 days.

How warm is this zip hoodie for early tee times?
It is a midweight fleece zip-up in 50% cotton and 50% polyester at 8 oz per square yard, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It suits a cool morning round, and you can unzip it on the cart path once the sun is up.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and fabric softener, and do not iron over the stitching. The golf ball on the chest and the LIE cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash.

Will it arrive in time for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 to have your golf zip hoodie before Christmas. Graphic Tees Co. makes each one to order, and orders over $45 ship free in the US, which this hoodie clears. It is an easy gift for the golfer who keeps a creative scorecard.
